## Context / Problem
`.github/workflows/_optionality.yml` job `clean-core-wheel`, step "degradation-path tests run with NO agents extra" (lines 149-168), runs pytest against `tests/interfaces/store/test_llm_optionality.py` and `tests/interfaces/lifecycle/test_completion_gate.py::test_gate_missing_llm_fails_closed` with no predates-gate guard. This workflow IS on the Verified lane (`gerrit-verify.yaml:252` invokes it against the exact patchset), so on a patchset whose base predates either test file pytest collects nothing and exits 4 — a `Verified -1` caused by the gate rather than by the change under review. That is exactly bug `1909-c1a7-9f20-440f`, which the SAME workflow already fixed for the step below it (`_optionality.yml:133` guards `tests/interfaces/contracts/test_cli_registry_distribution.py`) — the fix landed in one copy and its twin stayed broken.

## Approach
Guard the two test files independently, following the two-generator form at `_optionality.yml:108,114` (bug `5bc6-5496-4e17-403a`): a joint guard would silence the check for the file that IS present. Build the pytest node-id list from the files that exist and skip only the absent ones, keeping the canonical "change predates the gate" message.

## Scope
`.github/workflows/_optionality.yml`.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Each of the two test files is guarded independently, so a tree with one and not the other still runs the one it has; checked by a case in `tests/unit/test_ci_workflow_parity.py` covering all four presence combinations.
- [ ] The step carries an `-f` guard naming each test file it runs; checked by `pytest tests/unit/test_predates_gate_guard_parity.py::test_completeness_every_gate_step_is_guarded_or_marked` passing with the marker REMOVED from that step.
- [ ] The guarded body exits 0 and prints the canonical message in an empty directory; checked by `pytest tests/unit/test_predates_gate_guard_parity.py::test_empty_tree_every_guarded_step_skips_cleanly`.
- [ ] The clean-lane assertion that the agents extra is ABSENT still runs; checked by `pytest tests/unit/test_ci_workflow_parity.py` passing unchanged.
